text_block_list.text:
Gold City defeated Tamamo Cross. Yet even 
in victory, people only praised how she 
looked running—no voices praised her 
actual strength.

In contrast, even in defeat, Tamamo 
Cross's running drew widespread acclaim. 
Faced with the stark contrast between 
them, Gold City felt utterly crushed.

Furious at Gold City's half-hearted 
running, Tamamo Cross demands to know, 
"What are you running for?!" ...Gold City 
could not answer.

Gold City vents to her Trainer that 
nothing she does changes how people see 
her. Yet when asked if she will quit 
running, she refuses to nod.

Realizing she doesn't want to give up on 
running, her Trainer sets their sights on 
the Spring Senior Triple Crown and decides 
to enter the Osaka Hai.
